prompt: What is the name of the town or city of birth of the player who won the men's singles at the US Open on the year after Venus & Serena Williams played each other for the 8th time as pros?
answer:
The 8th professional meeting between Venus and Serena Williams was at the **2002 Wimbledon final**. The following year, **Andy Roddick** won the 2003 US Open men’s singles title.

Roddick was born in **Omaha, Nebraska**.
